title: Making Cross-Continental Federated Learning Repeatable with FLIP: a Multi-Application Study
abstract: arXiv:2609.36001v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated learning (FL) in healthcare remains challenging, as the overhead of rebuilding governance guarantees for every collaboration stops most projects at the proof-of-concept stage. Here we present FLIP (Federated Learning Interoperability Platform), an open-source, multi-application platform that makes FL training and evaluation repeatable. FLIP implements common FL workflows as a set of composable services: cohort queries against per-site structured databases, on-demand DICOM retrieval from institutional PACS, per-site project approval, and reusable FL job types. To demonstrate FLIP, we ran two distinct use cases, federated fine-tuning and federated evaluation, on synthetic chest X-ray cohorts across two client nodes based in the United Kingdom (UK) and Thailand. translated_abstract: 医疗保健领域的联邦学习（FL）仍然充满挑战，因为每次协作都需要重建治理保障的开销使大多数项目停留在概念验证阶段。本文提出了FLIP（联邦学习互操作性平台），这是一个开源的多应用平台，能够使联邦学习的训练和评估具有可重复性。FLIP将常见的联邦学习工作流程实现为一组可组合的服务：针对各站点结构化数据库的队列查询、从机构PACS系统按需检索DICOM图像、各站点的项目审批，以及可复用的联邦学习作业类型。为了展示FLIP，我们在位于英国和泰国的两个客户端节点上，针对合成胸部X光数据集运行了两个不同的用例：联邦微调和联邦评估。在FLIP中，每个机构独立审批其参与每个项目，并在本地IT安全流程下运营自己的节点。本研究提供了一套可操作的……
tldr: 提出开源多应用平台FLIP，将联邦学习工作流实现为可组合的服务（队列查询、DICOM检索、项目审批和可复用作业类型），使英国与泰国两地节点的医疗联邦学习训练与评估变得可重复。
